documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On Friday, June 19, 2026 - Ref: Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ('Listing Regulations')

analysis.summary: Shringar House of Mangalsutra Limited reported its Q4 and full year FY26 earnings, highlighting strategic milestones including successful company listing, manufacturing capacity expansion, and entry into the bridal jewellery segment. Management reiterated its growth guidance of delivering approximately 30% growth over the next two to three years. Financial results showed significant year-on-year growth in revenue, gross profit, EBITDA, and profit after tax. The company also discussed working capital requirements, hedging mechanisms, and client-wise revenue contributions. Shringar House of Mangalsutra Limited released its investor presentation for Q4 and FY26, highlighting strong financial and operational performance with revenue from operations reaching INR 2,246 crores for FY26.

guidance.claim: Management remains committed to its guidance of delivering approximately 30% growth over the next two to three years.
guidance.quote: We remain committed to our guidance of delivering approximately 30% growth over the next two to three years.

guidance.claim: Management stated that projected CAGR in terms of value is easily achievable within the 30% range over the next two to three years.
guidance.quote: Therefore, looking ahead over the next two to three years, our projected CAGR in terms of value is easily achievable within the 30% range.

guidance.claim: The company expects to continue growing at a CAGR of approximately 30%.
guidance.quote: Sir I can say that the CAGR at which we are growing is approximately 30% CAGR, and we will continue to grow at that same CAGR and of course if how much ever the corporate grows, we can grow even further based on that.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that high-potential markets in Western India are witnessing increased demand for organized jewellery retail.
demand_outlook.quote: These two high-potential markets are witnessing increased demand for organized jewellery retail.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the number of weddings increases by approximately 7% to 8% annually, causing the gold jewellery industry to expand at a corresponding pace.
demand_outlook.quote: Thus, with the volume of weddings increasing by approximately 7% to 8% annually, the gold jewellery industry is also advancing and expanding at a corresponding pace.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the expansion plans of corporate clientele will drive additional demand for products.
demand_outlook.quote: The expansion plans of our corporate clientele will drive additional demand for our products

demand_outlook.claim: Organized retailers are aggressively adding store count pan-India, which will drive additional demand for gold jewellery and the company's products.
demand_outlook.quote: These organized retailers are aggressively adding store count pan-India and thus as an established supplier, their expansion plans will drive additional demand for gold jewellery including our products.

capex_expansion.claim: The company executed a major expansion of manufacturing capabilities resulting in an increase in production capacity from 2,500 kgs to 4,000 kgs.
capex_expansion.quote: Firstly, we executed a major expansion of our manufacturing capabilities during the fourth quarter, resulting in a meaningful increase in production capacity from 2,500 kgs to 4,000 kgs.

capex_expansion.claim: The company inaugurated a new branch office in Pune to enhance its geographic footprint in Western India.
capex_expansion.quote: As a part of our ongoing expansion strategy, we successfully inaugurated a new branch office in Pune, a move that has significantly enhanced our geographic footprint in Western India from Marathwada to Vidarbha regions.

capex_expansion.claim: The company made a strategic entry into the bridal jewellery segment as a natural extension to its core mangalsutra business.
capex_expansion.quote: Secondly, we made a strategic entry into the bridal jewellery segment, which represents a natural extension to our core mangalsutra business.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested approximately 15 crore rupees via internal accruals to expand capacity, upgrade machinery, improve efficiency, and meet growing demand.
capex_expansion.quote: Approx. ₹15 crore invested via internal accruals to expand capacity, upgrade machinery, improve efficiency, and meet growing demand.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production from current capacity resumed from 23rd February 2026, with 57% capacity utilization.
capex_expansion.quote: Commercial production from the current capacity resumed from 23rd February 2026, with 57% capacity utilization.

capex_expansion.claim: The board approved shifting the manufacturing facility to a larger space in Mumbai to enhance efficiency, upgrade technology, and increase capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: We have also received approval to shift our manufacturing facility to a larger space in Mumbai itself. The relocation is being undertaken to enhance operational efficiency, upgrade technology and infrastructure and increase production capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The new facility's capacity will be almost double the existing capacity.

margins_costs.quote: Gross profit margin stood at 8.3% expanded by 169 basis point over year to year.

orders_capacity.claim: Blended capacity for the year stood at 2,625 kgs, leading to an effective capacity utilization of 87% for FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: As a result, the blended capacity for the year stood at 2,625 kgs, leading to an effective capacity utilization of 87% for FY '26.

orders_capacity.claim: For the next financial year, available installed capacity stays at 4,000 kgs.
orders_capacity.quote: For the next financial year, our available installed capacity stays at 4,000 kgs, and we expect to further ramp up production in the coming quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volume for the fourth quarter stood at 500 kgs, up 16% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales volume for the fourth quarter stood at 500 kgs, up 16% Y-o-Y.

orders_capacity.claim: Actual capacity utilization was reported at 87% for the full year, taking into account blended capacity.
The manufacturing facility has a total capacity of 2,500 kgs and operates at approximately 70% capacity utilization levels.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently our manufacturing facility has the total capacity of 2,500 kgs and is working approximately 70% capacity utilization levels, allowing us to produce wide range of Mangalsutras under one roof.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volume for Q3 FY26 reached 551.2 kg, up 3.4% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales volume for quarter 3 financial year 26 to date 551.2 kg up 3.4% Y-o-Y.

capital_allocation.claim: The debt-equity ratio for financial year 26 remained at 0.27.

capital_allocation.claim: Funds raised through the issue strengthened the working capital position by increasing the inventory base and scaling efficiency.
capital_allocation.quote: The fund raised through this issue have therefore strengthened our working capital position by allowing us to increase our inventory base and enhance our ability to scale efficiently.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that hedging gold results in a notional loss due to additional payments required from gold price increases.
risks_headwinds.quote: Since we hedge gold, it results in a notional loss because if we have hedged the gold at whatever price we have bought it at in MCX, whatever additional payment we have to make due to increase in the price of gold, that actually results in loss.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company utilizes a comprehensive hedging policy and gold metal loans to protect against raw material price volatility.
risks_headwinds.quote: I would also like to highlight that we have comprehensive hedging policy in place to protect ourselves from volatility of raw material prices.

management_commitments.claim: Management is committed to delivering approximately 30% growth over the next two to three years.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to our guidance of delivering approximately 30% growth over the next two to three years.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that production is expected to ramp up in the coming quarters.
management_commitments.quote: The production is expected to ramp up in the coming quarters.
